title: Dinosaur Drawing on a 96 Well Plate
author: Opentrons
materials: Download your protocol and unzip if needed.

steps.title: Download and unzip protocol
steps.instruction: Download the protocol package and unzip it if necessary.

steps.title: Upload custom labware (if needed)
steps.instruction: In the OT App go to More → Custom Labware → Add Labware and upload any custom labware JSON files.

steps.title: Upload protocol file
steps.instruction: Upload the protocol .py file to the OT App in the Protocol tab.

steps.title: Set up deck with labware
steps.instruction: Place a compatible 96‑well plate on the deck (e.g., Bio‑Rad 96‑Well Plate 200 µL PCR, NEST 96‑Well Plate 100 µL PCR Full Skirt, Corning 96‑Well Plate 360 µL Flat, or NEST 96‑Well Plate 200 µL Flat) and load the appropriate tip racks (Opentrons 300 µL Tips or Opentrons 200 µL Filter Tips).

steps.title: Calibrate robot
steps.instruction: Calibrate the labware, tip rack, and pipette (P300 Single‑Channel GEN2) using the OT App’s calibration routine.

steps.title: Distribute green solution
steps.instruction: Using the P300 Single‑Channel GEN2 with 200 µL filter tips (or 300 µL tips), aspirate 50 µL of green food‑coloring solution and dispense it into all designated wells.

steps.title: Distribute blue solution
steps.instruction: Using the same pipette and tip configuration, aspirate 50 µL of blue food‑coloring solution and dispense it into all designated wells.

steps.title: Enjoy the dinosaur
steps.instruction: Observe the pattern formed on the 96‑well plate; the green and blue droplets should depict a Stegosaurus.

steps.title: Run the protocol
steps.instruction: Press ‘Run’ in the OT App to execute the protocol on the robot.
